title: 第七章 商战
content_zh:
一阵清风徐徐而过,却没有消散空气中的紧张气氛。

    江尘望着那缓缓出现的人影,心中很是警惕。一旁的虎芸也显得很是紧张,千年冰莲是江尘冒着生命危险采摘到的,她自然是不会轻易拱手相送的。

    当他们看清楚来人的脸时,都是为之吓了一跳。眼前的少年,年纪约莫十二三岁,却散发出一丝英气。一身锦衣华服,腰间悬着一柄蓝色的宝剑,一看便知不是寻常之物。而少年长相虽然颇为俊美,但却透出一股阴冷。

    这正是江尘当初心中很忌惮的那个少年,商战。

    商战缓缓走到江尘与虎芸面前,当他看清楚两人的容貌之时,也是不禁皱眉。商战乃是神叶帝国明侯商震天之子,自然是认识虎芸的,也知道其真实的身份。而江尘虽然看上去很普通,却让商战心中产生了一丝警惕。

    “商战?你不是直接通过了吗,来这里干嘛?”虎芸警惕的看着商战,不解的问道。

    而商战却是一脸冷淡,看也不看虎芸,声音宛若万里冰河一般冷漠。“不关你的事,放下千年冰莲,赶紧滚蛋。”

    虎芸闻言,立时感到无比愤怒,当即厉声道:“商战,你敢这样跟本小姐说话,活得不耐烦了吗?”话虽这样说,虎芸心里却是没有一丝底气,只能是看向江尘。

    “哼,还是那句话,放下千年冰莲,赶紧滚蛋。看在你那老子的份上,本少爷今天就不出手教训你了,否则别怪本少爷无情。”商战依旧冷冷的看着江尘与虎芸,十分冷漠的说道。

    “这位兄弟,这千年冰莲可是我费了九牛二虎之力才弄到手的。你说一句话就想让我将其交给你,是不是有点太把自己当回事了吧。”江尘也看出商战的背景不简单,却并不打算将之交出。

    商战却是眼神微寒,冷笑道:“哪里来的贱民,也敢这样跟本少爷说话。你可知道,我的父亲乃是神叶帝国大名鼎鼎的明侯商震天,我的姨母可是神皇陛下最宠爱的商妃商诗嫣。识相的话,就把千年冰莲乖乖放在本少爷面前,再向本少爷磕头赔罪,或许你还能活下去。”

    江尘却是哈哈一笑,戏谑道:“呵呵,我看你一定是被门夹了,不然怎么满口都是胡话。倒不如你给小爷我跪下,叫几声爷爷,磕几个响头,我就把千年冰莲给你怎么样?”

    一旁的虎芸听到江尘的话,却是丝毫笑不起来。她贵为武威王千金,自然是知道商战的底细。也知道,商战在商家极为受宠,而商家背后便是商妃与其子二皇子叶天。不要说江尘了,即便是她的父亲也是不敢随意开罪商家的。

    因而听到江尘的话,虎芸便立即扯了扯江尘的衣角,示意他不要再说下去,免得激怒商战。可偏偏江尘是个软硬都不吃的主,只要是惹到了他,就算是天王老子他也敢惹。
content_en:
A gust of breeze passed by slowly, but it did not dissipate the tension in the air.

    Jiang Chen looked at the figure that slowly appeared, feeling very vigilant in his heart. Hu Yun on the side also looked very nervous. Jiang Chen risked his life to pick the Millennium Ice Lotus, so naturally she would not give it away easily.

    When they saw the face of the visitor clearly, they were all startled. The young man in front of him was about twelve or thirteen years old, but he exuded a trace of heroism. Dressed in rich brocade clothes, with a blue sword hanging from his waist, one could tell at a glance that it was not an ordinary thing. Although the young man looks quite handsome, there is a coldness about him.

    This was the young man that Jiang Chen was very afraid of at the beginning, Shang Zhan.

    Shang Zhan slowly walked up to Jiang Chen and Hu Yun. When he saw their faces clearly, he couldn't help but frown. Shang Zhan is the son of Shang Zhentian, the Minghou of the Shenye Empire. Naturally, he knows Huyun and his true identity. Although Jiang Chen looked ordinary, it made Shang Zhan feel a little wary.

    "Shang Zhan? Didn't you pass directly? What are you doing here?" Hu Yun looked at Shang Zhan warily and asked in confusion.

    But Shang Zhan had a cold expression on his face, not even looking at Hu Yun, and his voice was as cold as a thousand-mile glacier. "It's none of your business, put down the Millennium Ice Lotus and get out of here."

    When Hu Yun heard this, she immediately felt extremely angry and said sternly: "Shang Zhan, do you dare to talk to me like this? Are you tired of living?" Although she said this, Hu Yun didn't have any confidence in her heart and could only look at Jiang Chen.

    "Humph, I'm still saying the same thing, put down the Millennium Ice Lotus and get out of here. For your sake, I won't teach you a lesson today, otherwise don't blame me for being ruthless." Shang Zhan still looked at Jiang Chen and Hu Yun coldly and said indifferently.

    "Brother, I spent a lot of effort to get this Thousand-Year Ice Lotus. You just want me to hand it over to you, don't you take yourself too seriously?" Jiang Chen also saw that the background of Shang Zhan was not simple, but he had no intention of handing it over.

    However, Shang Zhan's eyes were slightly cold and he sneered: "How dare you talk to this young master like this, a pariah? Do you know that my father is the famous Minghou Shang Zhentian of the Divine Leaf Empire, and my aunt is His Majesty the Divine Emperor's favorite concubine Shang Shiyan. If you are wise, you can obediently place the Millennium Ice Lotus in front of this young master, and then kowtow to this young master to apologize. Maybe you can still live."

    Jiang Chen laughed and said jokingly: "Haha, I think you must have been caught in the door, otherwise you would be talking nonsense. How about you kneel down, call me grandpa a few times, kowtow a few times, and I will give you the Millennium Ice Lotus?"

    Hu Yun on the side heard Jiang Chen's words, but she couldn't laugh at all. She is the daughter of King Wuwei, so she naturally knows the details of the business war. We also know that Shang Zhan is extremely popular among merchants, and behind the merchants are the concubine Shang and her son, the second prince Ye Tian. Not to mention Jiang Chen, even her father would not dare to offend the merchant at will.

    So after hearing Jiang Chen's words, Hu Yun immediately tugged on Jiang Chen's clothes and signaled him to stop talking, so as not to anger Shang Zhan. But Jiang Chen is a master who doesn't take hard or soft words. As long as he is offended, he will dare to offend even the King of Heaven.
